title: SEMIR: Topology-Preserving Graph Minors for Thin-Structure Segmentation
mechanism: Replace the pixel lattice with a graph minor whose contraction preserves 1-3 px structures; a GNN classifies supernodes and an exact map lifts predictions to pixels.
adaptation: Build the minor with EL ridge filters so crack px are never merged into background; GNN on house encoder features; aimed at fragmentation (components found).
min_experiment: Arm SEMIR crack classifier vs PF; metric components >=20 px found; kill if +<0.02.
evidence: TTPLA power lines, CrackSeg9k, SkyScapes lanes: matches or beats domain baselines on Dice, IoU, Boundary F1; fragmentation at least 4.6x lower than SLIC.
